simple.meaning: מָעוֹן (Mâʻôwn) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with flocks.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Joshua, Judges, 1 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, beginning at Joshua 15:55. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָעוֹן (H4584) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מָעוֹן through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.short: Maon , the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H4584. Maon II. מָעוֺן proper name 1. location in Judah Josh 15:55 (P), 1Sam 25:2 ( ᵐ5 Μααν , Μαων ), now Ma`în (Buhl Geogr. 163 and references ), 8 miles south of Hebron; hence מ ׳מִדְבַּר 23:24-25 , (twice in verse), so read also 25:1 (for פארן ᵑ0 ) ᵐ5 Th We Dr Bu Klo Kit Löhr; compare 2. masculine in Judah 1Chr 2:45 (twice in verse), ᵐ5 Μεων , Μαων . 3. of a people Judg 10:12 named with Sidonians and Amalek as ancient foes of Israel; possibly intended by writer as = מְעוּנִים q. v.; many read מִדְיָן ( ᵐ5 B A ᵐ5 L Μαδιαμ ); see GFM. — מְעוֺן see מְעוֺן בַּעַל בֵּית ; 1Chr 4:41 see מְעוּנִים .
